'''Matt Upstone''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[October 2000 Green Bay tournament]] on 14 October 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA Scum (anti-TIGIH Speeders)]], according to Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1355">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-gb-10-14d1355/ gb-10-14], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-gb-10-14d1355/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
